symbolDescription: Every CSS custom property the built-in components read. Set any of them on an ancestor of the globe to theme it; each use falls back to a literal when unset.

tokenDescriptions.--globe-color-label: Text on the globe: country and capital names, graticule labels, tooltip text and control icons.
tokenDescriptions.--globe-color-accent: Accent: the capital dot and focus outlines.
tokenDescriptions.--globe-color-outline: Outline around markers: the capital dot ring and the cluster border.
tokenDescriptions.--globe-surface-card: Raised surfaces: the pin popup and the control buttons.
tokenDescriptions.--globe-border-strong: Borders of the pin popup and the control buttons.
tokenDescriptions.--globe-r-sm: Small corner radius: the country tooltip.
tokenDescriptions.--globe-r-md: Medium corner radius: the pin popup.
tokenDescriptions.--globe-shadow-md: Medium drop shadow: the cluster marker and the country tooltip.
tokenDescriptions.--globe-shadow-lg: Large drop shadow: the pin popup.
